column8: TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 3 (NCT05026866, 2,996 participants) enrols people with neither dementia nor mild cognitive impairment: the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, eligibilityModule, checked 2026-11-09) gives ages 55 to 80, requires 'a Telephone Interview for Cognitive Status - modified (TICS-M) score reflective of intact cognitive functioning' and 'a phosphorylated tau (P-tau) result consistent with the presence of amyloid pathology', and excludes mild cognitive impairment. The primary endpoint is time to clinical progression in participants whose baseline Clinical Dementia Rating is 0. Kisunla's label is the mild cognitive impairment and mild dementia stage, so none of this population is in it, and the registry indexes the study under Alzheimer Disease, the same descriptor the symptomatic studies get. The second preclinical study, NCT07571161, enrols in China and is not named here because the book models the US.
